about: What port/tools/hostgen/release_carry_rac3.py needs of NTSC-U besides rac3-decomp's tables and rac3-pal's port: the keys of hostgen.json that are this disc's own, the pairs and addresses checked by hand, each with its evidence.

hostgen.about: Keys over rac3-pal's carried hostgen.json (null removes one; a dict is merged unless it has "replace").
hostgen.title: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal (NTSC-U)
hostgen.tick_rate_why: The NTSC-U game leaves its settings word 0x00143950 at 0 and takes the 60 Hz branch PAL never takes (rac3-pal/README.md, Ticks): it counts in sixtieths.

func_003F02C8.why: the Widget3D text class's type id (jr ra; li v0, 2): the same 8 bytes at 0x003F0168, after the same 36-byte remnant (PAL 0x003F02A0, NTSC-U 0x003F0140), and the class's vtable (PAL 0x001D9798, NTSC-U 0x001D97D8) points there at +0xC. NTSC-U's inventory counts the 8 bytes into f_003F0140, so map.tsv has no twin; without it the main menu's labels were never set (func_003E7EE8 looked their setter up under a garbage type id)

func_003F0AB8.why: the next class's type id: the same 8 bytes at 0x003F0938, after the same 20-byte remnant (PAL 0x003F0AA0, NTSC-U 0x003F0920), the only place they occur after it; as func_003F02C8

func_003EFF10__frontbin.why: frontbin's copy of func_003F02C8: the same 8 bytes at 0x003EA9A8 after the same 36-byte remnant (PAL 0x003EFEE8, NTSC-U 0x003EA980)

func_003F0700__frontbin.why: frontbin's copy of func_003F0AB8: the same 8 bytes at 0x003EB178 after the same 20-byte remnant (PAL 0x003F06E8, NTSC-U 0x003EB160), the only place they occur
